title: Tick index excluded from per-tick state hash; frozen tail cannot be distinguished from a stalled sim
detail: Forty consecutive identical hashes prove the tick counter is not part of the hashed 'full sim state'. A prematurely frozen or stalled simulation is indistinguishable from a legitimately won one in this golden format.
recommended_fix: Fold the tick index into the per-tick hash, or emit an explicit ended/frozen marker line so post-end stalls fail the golden comparison.
